name: whatsapp-chat-recovery
description: Privacy-first WhatsApp recovery, read-only forensic triage, and a stateless OpenAI MCP planning app.

interface.shortDescription: Recover and audit your own WhatsApp backups and browser artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Guided WhatsApp recovery with read-only inventory of Android backups, exports, and Chromium/WhatsApp Web IndexedDB-LevelDB artifacts, plus a stateless OpenAI MCP planning app and in-chat widget. Local auditing and remote decision support stay separated so source artifacts, credentials, and message bodies are not sent to the MCP app.
defaultPrompt: Plan the safest recovery route for my own WhatsApp data.
Review this metadata-only WhatsApp artifact audit.
